Quick update — tested a 2k-concurrency emulation on dedicated pool with redwood-xy-4k q4_8bit profile.

Findings:
- 95th perc latency (simulated best-effort) ~ 240ms when using default batching; can hit target (<=220ms) with lower batch window (tune live during POC)
- Memory headroom is tight for long context (32k tokens); recommend limiting eval prompts to 8k context for initial run

Blocker: the SOC2 questionnaire has a few vendor-specific questions around logging retention that require security's input. I've attached the partially filled form.

Proposed mitigation:
- Start POC with constrained context and incremental ramp to 16k
- Rishi to confirm retention policy and provide text we can include in SOW

Attachment: security_questionnaire_fill.pdf

-ben
